text:
Maria L.: Heads up — Marketplace team needs final signoff on kernel/driver pins for next image rollout. Targeting NVIDIA driver 535.86 + CUDA 12.2, ROCm 5.7. Need partner OK and canary plan. @Julio can you sync with partners?
Julio (partner-liaison): On it. I have a call with NVIDIA tomorrow 10:30 PT and AMD at 3pm PT. Will ask for formal compatibility ack and any micro-patch notes.
Kevin B.: FYI runtime team ran perf baseline against 535.86 + CUDA12.2 yesterday. No regression on p95 for small batches, but we saw ~6% perf dip on long-context quant kernels.
Sanjay R.: Can you paste the job id? I want to check kernel symbols and if it's a cudnn fallback path.
Kevin B.: job 2024-rt-9832 — logs in CI. Quick snippet: `nv_driver=535.86 cuda=12.2 kernel=qopt` — looks like new cuBLAS kernel selection changed for block size.
Partner:NVIDIA: Thanks for the heads up. We'll surface any known micro-patches. 535.86 is on our recommended list for CUDA12.2 but we need to validate your quant kernels. Can we get a small repro and your perf matrix?
Julio (partner-liaison): @Partner:NVIDIA I'll share the perf matrix and a minimal repro container by EOD. Also asking for a signed compatibility note we can attach to the marketplace listing.
Partner:AMD: ROCm 5.7 is fine on our end for standard TF/PyTorch paths. We have an open note about a kernel ordering change that can affect async memcpy in a few cases — will send a short mitigation we use (llc flush ordering).
Emma (eng-sre): Let's lock down canary rollout plan here: 1) internal canary (10 nodes, driver 535.86/CUDA12.2) 2) partner canary with NVIDIA (staged region) 3) marketplace small % rollout (1%) 4) roll forward to GA. Rollback playbook needs driver rollback + image tag revert.
Sanjay R.: Agree. Also adding automated health checks: tokenized perf sentinel (p95 < 50ms), error-rate < 0.5%, and KV cache hit-rate sanity. If any sentinel trips, auto-rollback to last-good tag.
Maria L.: Please confirm who will sign the compatibility note and expected calendar. We need partner signoff before Friday so marketplace publishing stays on Monday next week.
Julio (partner-liaison): NVIDIA asked for the repro by EOD today, they expect 48h to sign. AMD will send mitigation guidance within 24h. Tentative signoff window: Friday afternoon.
Partner:NVIDIA: We'll try to speed this up — if your repro shows the regression we can triage early. Also can we get the kernel config used for quant builds?
Kevin B.: Pushed quant kernel config to the shared drive: `s3://redwood-ci/quant-kernels/2024/535_86/`. Link: https://s3.redwood/quant-kernels/2024/535_86/
DeployBot: Canary cluster spin-up successful (canary-2024-11). Image tag: marketplace-2024.11-canary-1. Drivers: 535.86, CUDA:12.2, ROCm:5.7.
Emma (eng-sre): Running canary smoke now — will report p95 and error rates in 30m. If green, we'll proceed to partner canary. :thumbsup:
Sanjay R.: If you see the 6% perf drop on long-context, try `--kv-alloc=split` as an interim config to avoid fused kernel path; it's in runtime flags doc.
Maria L.: Great. Keep thread updated with partner notes and signoff. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
